I need to search for information about these terms and their religious association.

<search>
Sufferers Locksmen Dreads followers religion
</search>

<search>
Rastafari Sufferers Locksmen Dreads
</search>

<search>
"Sufferers" "Locksmen" "Dreads" religion
</search>

Answer: Rastafarianism (or Rastafari). These are all terms associated with followers of the Rastafari movement - "Sufferers" refers to Rastafarians who emphasize the suffering of black people, "Locksmen" refers to those who wear dreadlocks, and "Dreads" is another term for Rastafarians who wear dreadlocks.
